functional.statement: Immunoblot of L001's PBMCs: A20/actin ratio after TNFα stimulation 0.453 vs healthy-control mean 0.802 (three controls, one at 0.216). The authors used L001 as a reference sample; they did not test the variant itself.

quotes.quote: (P1: 0.205; P2 0.218; L001 0.453 versus mean ratio HC:0.802, see Supplementary Table 1)

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Single-nucleotide deletion predicted to cause a frameshift (batch: p.(Ala437ProfsTer40)). The authors label it a loss-of-function mutation.

quotes.quote: L001: CVID patient control with *TNFAIP3* LoF mutation c.1309del (p.Ala437Profs).

concerns: The variant appears only as a laboratory control. There is no case description, sex, age, zygosity, family data or genetic method.
No transcript is given, and the protein is truncated in the paper ('p.Ala437Profs', no stop position). The batch predicts p.(Ala437ProfsTer40).
The phenotype is given only as CVID, not the Behçet-like features. Whether other causes of CVID were checked is not reported.
notes_for_panel: Very thin evidence. The panel may want to look for a primary report of L001 elsewhere; this paper does not cite one.
